test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The LCM of two numbers is 840 and their HCF is 7 . If one of the numbers is 56 , find the other.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Property: Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

Second Number = (HCF × LCM) ÷ First Number

Second Number = (7 × 840) ÷ 56 = 105

**∴ The correct answer is 105.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

HCF = 7

LCM = 840

First Number = 56

**Formula:**

First Number × Second Number = HCF × LCM

 
 Number 1 × Number 2
 =
 
 HCF × LCM
 
• 
 56 × x
 
• 
 7 × 840
 x = (7 × 840) ÷ 56 = 105

⇒ Let the second number be x.

⇒ 56 × x = 7 × 840

⇒ x = (7 × 840) ÷ 56

⇒ x = 5880 ÷ 56

⇒ x = 105

**∴ The correct answer is 105.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product Rule for Two Numbers

For any two positive integers a and b, HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = a × b. This rule only applies to exactly two numbers.

HCF and LCM of Fractions

HCF of fractions = (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators) and LCM of fractions = (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators).

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are said to be co-prime if their HCF is 1. For such numbers, their LCM is simply their product (LCM = a × b).</p
